scope: RB2d logo set, concept B (headless playhead bar), round 2 after the concept pick (final)

first_glance.tab_16px: A small ruler with a red vertical line through it, black on the left and grey on the right; reads as a scrub position, with the ticks a fine comb at this size.
first_glance.readme_header: A ruler with a red cursor beside the heavy wordmark; clearly a timeline marker. The mark is larger than before and sits better against the letters, but the thin rule and thin ticks still look lighter than the 800 weight.
first_glance.avatar_96: A black and grey ruler with a tall red bar through the middle; reads as a scrub bar in half a second. The bar is narrower than before but is still the heaviest element.
first_glance.avatar_20: A red vertical stroke on a black-and-grey line; the ticks are mush, but the red cut on a split line still reads as a position marker. The circle edge is invisible on a light page, as intended.
first_glance.mark_alone: A ruler with matching end ticks, a rule as thin as a tick and a red bar cut through it, past black and undone grey; the concept is clear and clean. The bar is still about three tick widths wide, so it reads as a block rather than a hairline cursor.

rows.item: Concept reads (playhead on a step ruler, scrubbed back)
rows.evidence: The rule now matches the tick width (about 16 px against 16 px on the 1024 logo), so the bar-chart base is gone and the ruler reads as a ruler. The headless bar cannot be a funnel or tee, ticks are symmetric with equal gaps, taller ticks sit only at the outer ends, and black past against grey undone carries the rewind idea. Remaining fault: the bar is about 51 px wide on the 1024 logo against 16 px ticks, still about three tick widths, so it reads as a red block more than a cursor line, and the ruler is uniformly light and spindly beside it.

The 16 px drawing in the tab (light and dark) and favicon-32 keeps the red line, the split rule and the ticks distinct, with clean coral on the dark ground. The silhouette is wide and flat. The 2 px bar at 16 px is the agreed pick, and it holds. At true 16 px the ticks are one pixel and read as a fine comb; in the 20 px avatar crop the ruler detail is lost and only a red stroke on a line remains. The 64 px tiles on the sheet are a true 4x of the small drawing and hold.

Bricolage Grotesque 800, lowercase, even spacing and no collisions at 1024 and on the 1280 social preview. The stacked lockup keeps the mark width (about 545 px) close to the wordmark span (about 755 px) with a clear gap. In the horizontal lockups the mark is now larger and the bar reaches the cap line, which is a real improvement, though the thin rule and ticks still look lighter than the heavy letters. Minor.

rows.item: Palette fidelity and distinctness from John's other brands
rows.evidence: Paper ground, ink, red on light, coral on dark and the grey for the undone side match BRAND.md by eye. The dark pages are the true near-black Reel, not blue-black. No purple, navy or emblem shape, so it sits apart from John's other brands. Grey undone ticks are soft on paper but legible and deliberate.

logo-light and logo-dark use the same layout on both grounds with good margin and a clean swap to coral and light ink; the mark-to-wordmark gap is comfortable. avatar-512 centres the ruler (about x72-440) with the bar extending evenly above and below the rule, and the bar is now narrower (about 34 px). Weak: the avatar has no wordmark, so it is a wide flat band with large empty paper above and below, and the circle crops at 96, 48 and 20 px are on the in-use sheet but invisible on a light page, so the crop cannot be judged from the edge. The mark could fill more of the square.

1280x640: left-aligned wordmark, two-line tagline, real command in a hairline box in Commit Mono, credit line. The credit gap below the box (about 40 px) now sits close to the tagline-to-box gap (about 30 px), so the credit no longer floats. The mark on the right (about x736-1184, y148-400) is centred on the text block and balances the right half; left edge is consistent. Small points: the red bar is still a block at this size and the text block sits slightly high, with about 135 px below against 100 px above.

Flat fills only: no gradient, glow, shadow, emoji, 3D or mascot, and nothing centred by default except the two logo squares and the avatar. Text is limited to the wordmark, tagline, the command 'rewindagent rewind 12', the credit line and, on the in-use sheet, the install line, which a test (test_in_use_install_line_is_the_readme_install_line) ties to the README install line. That resolves the round-7 concern. No hostname issue seen in the rendered text beyond that documented install line.

fixes: Narrow the playhead bar from 1.5 units to 1 unit wide at 1024 and 512 (about two tick widths) and keep the 2 px bar at 16 px, so the bar reads as a cursor line instead of a block.
Thicken the ruler together: set tick width and rule thickness to 0.75 units (still equal to each other) so the ruler carries more weight beside the 800 wordmark.
Scale the mark in avatar-512 so the ruler spans about x48-464 instead of x72-440, which fills more of the square and keeps it legible inside the circle crop.
Raise the social preview text block by about 18 px so the space above and below it is equal (about 118 px each).
